verdict.rationale: Loading server data into reactive state with a suspense-style loading UI is a fair question for a UI framework with a fullstack meta-framework, so the axis applies. The evidence documents general reactivity ($state, $derived, $effect) and server rendering in SvelteKit. Nothing in the pack covers resource or suspense primitives, async data reactivity, or a loading or pending UI for server-loaded data. A community remark about clear load ordering is adjacent and does not show the capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can treat server-loaded data as reactive state and build a responsive loading UI for it using resource and suspense primitives
